python3 -c 'import json,sys,os
try:
    data=json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception:
    sys.exit(0)
fp=(data.get("tool_input") or {}).get("file_path") or ""
if not fp:
    sys.exit(0)
# realpath on both sides: macOS resolves /tmp -> /private/tmp at the kernel
# getcwd() level, which breaks a plain startswith() check for worktrees
# created under /tmp (the mandated worktree-driven-development location).
fp=os.path.realpath(fp)
root=os.path.realpath(os.getcwd())
rel=fp[len(root)+1:] if fp.startswith(root+"/") else (None if os.path.isabs(fp) else fp)
if rel is not None and rel.startswith("api-baseline/"):
    sys.stderr.write("api-baseline/ files are GENERATED contract goldens (swift-api-digester dumps) — never hand-edit. Regenerate instead: bash scripts/check-api-baseline.sh --update, then review the diff.\n")
    sys.exit(2)
'
